top_signals.title: Saudi Arabia Suggests Riyadh Airport May Reopen on Sunday
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia’s main airport was gearing up to reopen as early as Sunday after operations had been disrupted by a spate of attacks by Houthi rebels.
